title: Societal Biases in Retrieved Contents: Measurement Framework and Adversarial Mitigation for BERT Rankers
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. Its focus is on measuring and mitigating gender bias in information retrieval systems.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as its focus is on gender bias.
